title: Lost in the city
instructions: Turist Eva yolunu kaybetmiş ve bir polisten yardım istiyor. Uzun bir diyalog; yön ifadelerine ve tarifteki değişikliğe dikkat et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: eva
script.text: Excuse me. I'm lost. I'm looking for the Grand Hotel.

script.speaker: officer
script.text: The Grand Hotel? Is it on King Street?

script.speaker: eva
script.text: No, it's on Queen Street. Sorry, I have the address here.

script.speaker: officer
script.text: Ah, Queen Street. That's not far. Go straight on to the traffic lights.

script.speaker: eva
script.text: Straight on to the traffic lights. OK.

script.speaker: officer
script.text: Then turn right. Walk past the bank and the post office.

script.speaker: eva
script.text: Past the bank and the post office.

script.speaker: officer
script.text: Then turn left into Queen Street. The hotel is on the right, opposite the park.

script.speaker: eva
script.text: How long does it take on foot?

script.speaker: officer
script.text: About ten minutes. You can take the number six bus, but walking is faster now. The traffic is very bad.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the street of the hotel?
questions.feedback: Önce King Street denir ama otel Queen Street'te.
Trafik ışıklarına kadar düz git, sonra sağa dön.
